families.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful
families._definition: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations

members.tone: Lofty praise - credits a penetrating grasp of how things stand in relation, where *judgment* only names the faculty.
members._gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations

members.tone: The same commendation built plainly off the adjective, heavier in the mouth than *sagacity* and less polished for it.
members._gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations

members.tone: The flat name for the ability to tell relations apart, stating the capacity without the admiration *sagacity* loads onto it.
members._gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations

members.tone: The flat name of the faculty itself, stating that the capacity to tell relations apart is present without the admiration *sagacity* adds or the fineness *discernment* implies.
members._gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations

members.tone: Praise pitched at fineness - the stress falls on discriminating what a coarser mind would run together.
members._gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations

members.tone: Compact and admiring, with 'good' built into the word, and it covers seeing with the eyes or the figurative equivalent alike.
members._gloss: good discernment (either visually or as if visually)

members.tone: Approving at the workaday end - soundness in practical matters, the kind expected of anyone rather than marvelled at.
members._gloss: sound practical judgment

members.tone: The bare commendation, with 'good' carrying the whole judgement and no claim past soundness.
members._gloss: sound practical judgment

members.tone: Informal and hearty - the same practical soundness spoken of as a homely possession rather than an intellectual one.
members._gloss: sound practical judgment

members.tone: Informal and blunt, naming what *common sense* names with a grin at its own plainness.
members._gloss: sound practical judgment

members.tone: The barest member - practical soundness in one syllable, with nothing qualifying it.
members._gloss: sound practical judgment

members.tone: Homely and affectionate where *good sense* is flatly commendatory, though the soundness praised is the same.
members._gloss: sound practical judgment

members.tone: Formal praise for judgment that comes out well, not merely for having the faculty at all.
members._gloss: good judgment

members.tone: Praise for a tactful kind of knowing - steering clear of what would embarrass or distress before it arises.
members._gloss: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress

members.tone: Mild approval for the knack of heading off embarrassment or distress, stated as a plain quality where *discretion* sounds like a virtue one is credited with and *circumspection* like wariness.
members._gloss: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress

members.tone: Tilts the same skill toward wariness - looking all round a situation for the embarrassment or distress in it.
members._gloss: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress

families.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

members.tone: The plain name for holding steady when pressure is on, with none of the flourish *aplomb* brings to the same feat.
members._gloss: steadiness of mind under stress

members.tone: Bare and short — names the steady state itself rather than the effort of keeping it, which is what *composure* implies.
members._gloss: steadiness of mind under stress

members.tone: The flat quality-noun, describing the steadiness rather than admiring it as *equanimity* does.
members._gloss: steadiness of mind under stress

members.tone: Elevated and admiring — steadiness under stress treated as an evenness of temper worth crediting, well above workaday *calmness*.
members._gloss: steadiness of mind under stress

members.tone: Praise with a flourish: the coolness under strain reads as polished and assured, not merely maintained.
members._gloss: great coolness and composure under strain

members.tone: Puts the weight on self-certainty as the root of the coolness, plainer and less stylish than *aplomb*.
members._gloss: great coolness and composure under strain

members.tone: Informal and offhand — makes great steadiness under strain sound like something a person simply has, and can lose, where *sang-froid* makes it formal.
members._gloss: great coolness and composure under strain

members.tone: Adds balance and bearing to the coolness, praising how the strain is carried as much as the nerve behind it.
members._gloss: great coolness and composure under strain

members.tone: Formal and faintly glamorous — nerve praised as a chill that strain cannot reach, more theatrical than *composure*.
members._gloss: great coolness and composure under strain

members.tone: The freedom from stress sounds like an ease rested in, warmer than the unstirred flatness of *placidity*.
members._gloss: a disposition free from stress or emotion

members.tone: The plainest of these: a temperament with no emotional weather in it, and none of the loftiness of *serenity*.
members._gloss: a disposition free from stress or emotion

members.tone: Even and unruffled, the absence of emotion sounding closer to a settled flatness than to any achievement.
members._gloss: a disposition free from stress or emotion

members.tone: Lofty and admiring — an untroubled disposition raised almost to a grace, far above bare *quiet*.
members._gloss: a disposition free from stress or emotion

members.tone: Soothing rather than exalted: the stressless disposition praised as restfulness, without *serenity*'s elevation.
members._gloss: a disposition free from stress or emotion

members.tone: The same restful freedom from stress and emotion as *tranquillity*, carried under the single-l spelling.
members._gloss: a disposition free from stress or emotion

families.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice
families._definition: trouble or confusion resulting from complexity

members.tone: Names both the trouble and the confusion together, and locates the cause in complexity rather than in the person confused.
members._gloss: trouble or confusion resulting from complexity

members.tone: The plain word for what defeats understanding outright, and the one that can carry wonder alongside the bafflement rather than only frustration.
members._gloss: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained

members.tone: Formal, and frames the inexplicable thing as a posed puzzle rather than the open blankness of *mystery*.
members._gloss: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained

members.tone: Casts what cannot be explained as something withheld, as though understanding were being kept from you rather than simply out of reach.
members._gloss: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained

members.tone: Idiomatic and flat: shut to understanding with none of the allure *mystery* can carry, and no expectation of opening.
members._gloss: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained

members.tone: The confusion pictured as physically knotted, so the exasperation is with the mess itself rather than with any difficulty of thought.
members._gloss: something jumbled or confused

members.tone: Harsher than *tangle* - a jumble pulled tight, sounding hostile and past unpicking.
members._gloss: something jumbled or confused

members.tone: Makes the jumble something you are inside and lost in, with an intricacy *tangle* does not suggest.
members._gloss: something jumbled or confused

members.tone: Puts the weight on the shape of the trap - two branches, neither of them good - so the uncertainty has a hard structure to it.
members._gloss: state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavo

members.tone: Softer than *dilemma*, dwelling on the wavering state of the person stuck rather than on how bad the options are.
members._gloss: state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavo

families._definition: emotions experienced when in a state of well-being

members.tone: The plain term of the set, naming the feeling of well-being itself without saying whether it is quiet or loud.
members._gloss: emotions experienced when in a state of well-being

members.tone: French, and it bundles good humor in with the happiness where *happiness* names the feeling alone.
members._gloss: (French) happiness and good humor

members.tone: Joy and pleasure actively felt rather than merely possessed, warmer than *contentment* and quieter than *merriment*.
members._gloss: experiencing joy and pleasure

members.tone: The same joy and pleasure as *gladness*, given a fuller and more formal shape.
members._gloss: experiencing joy and pleasure

members.tone: Literary in cast, dressing the joy and pleasure of *gladness* in ornament the plainer form does without.
members._gloss: experiencing joy and pleasure

members.tone: Brightness and lightness in the feeling, weightless where *rejoicing* is full and heavy.
members._gloss: a gay feeling

members.tone: The same gay feeling with an outward, jolly noise on it that *gaiety* need not have.
members._gloss: a gay feeling

members.tone: The peak of the set, happiness raised to great intensity rather than left at an even glow.
members._gloss: a feeling of great happiness

members.tone: Pins the happiness to a secure relationship rather than leaving it a free-floating mood as *gladness* does.
members._gloss: happiness felt in a secure relationship

members.tone: Good spirits that rise unbidden, a steady sunniness rather than the crest of *rejoicing*.
members._gloss: a feeling of spontaneous good spirits

members.tone: The same spontaneous good spirits with a lighter, more carefree edge than *cheerfulness*.
members._gloss: a feeling of spontaneous good spirits

members.tone: The quietest member, happiness settled on one's situation in life instead of flaring at anything in particular.
members._gloss: happiness with one's situation in life
